verdict.rationale: OpenHands is an autonomous coding agent. Its docs describe diagnosing failures and fixing them: it detects failed workflows, inspects logs, identifies the likely cause and opens a PR with a proposed fix, and it remediates security alerts via PR. It also takes natural-language tasks and supports auto-approved, goal-driven runs. Bug-report handling is documented only as triage (gather logs, suggest severity, route), not as a reported-issue-to-fix flow. Missing for 10: an explicit documented workflow from a reported bug or issue to a fix, independent or hands-on corroboration of fix quality.
